title: A sandbox is lost, and waiting costs nothing
design_ref: Working state; Waiting for a person
purpose: Delete a run's sandbox while its tests are running, and see the files come back from the last snapshot. Then leave a run waiting for a reviewer while every worker is removed, approve it with nothing running, and see it carry on when workers return.

steps.display: kubectl -n sandboxes get pods   # the run's sandbox, while its tests run
steps.output:
NAME            READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
sb-s-3768c2c7   1/1     Running   0          18s

steps.display: SELECT step, snapshot_id, files FROM snapshots   # what is already safe in object storage
kubectl -n sandboxes delete pod sb-s-3768c2c7 --grace-period=0 --force   # the sandbox is lost, with its disk
steps.output: pod "sb-s-3768c2c7" force deleted from sandboxes namespace

steps.display: SELECT content FROM context_log WHERE step = 3 AND role = 'tool'   # the result the agent finally saw for its test run

steps.output:
t=   6.6s  run_tool            attempts=1
t=   7.0s  run_tool            attempts=1
t=   7.2s  snapshot_workspace  attempts=1
t=   7.5s  run_tool            attempts=1
t=   7.9s  snapshot_workspace  attempts=1
t=  74.3s  run_tool            attempts=2   last failure: tool gateway 500: RemoteDisconnected: Remote end closed connection without respo
t=  74.7s  run_tool            attempts=1
t=  75.1s  run_tool            attempts=1
model calls: 7   tokens: 2378

steps.display: kubectl -n sandboxes get pods   # the run is waiting for a reviewer: nothing is held
steps.output: No resources found in sandboxes namespace.
No resources found in agent-platform namespace.

steps.display: agentctl signal s-3768c2c7 approve   # the reviewer approves while no worker exists
agentctl status s-3768c2c7   # 20 seconds later, still with no worker
agentctl status s-3768c2c7   # after two new workers started

checks.description: the sandbox exists and two snapshots (after the two file writes) are already stored
checks.because: A snapshot is taken after every step that changes files.

checks.description: the run carried on to the review step
checks.because: The tool step failed when its sandbox vanished and was retried, in a new sandbox.

checks.description: the retried test run passed, so the files had been put back
checks.because: A new sandbox starts empty. The manager restored the files from the manifest of the last snapshot before the tests ran. Had it not, the test discovery would have found nothing and failed.

checks.description: the test step took more than one attempt in the history
checks.because: The engine, not the platform code, recorded the retry.

checks.description: the model was not called again for any step
checks.because: A sandbox loss is a tool failure, not a reason to ask the model again.

checks.description: the finished run's sandbox was released when it began waiting
checks.because: The waiting run holds no pod.

checks.description: with no worker at all, the run and the approval are safely held by the engine
checks.because: The approval is a row in the run's history. Nothing needs to be running to receive it.

checks.description: when workers returned, the run noticed the approval and finished
checks.because: A new worker replayed the history, found the approval in it, and continued.
No step was repeated by the long wait.
